item.title: Judge may soon rule on legality of privately funded White House ballroom
item.description: A federal judge will rule on whether Trump’s $400M White House ballroom, funded by private donations, can bypass congressional approval.

item.title: U.S. proposes stricter ‘Buy America’ rules for EV chargers
item.description: The Transportation Department proposes raising Buy America rules to up to 100% U.S. content for federally funded EV chargers, drawing backlash and legal scrutiny.

item.title: Public concern arises over Wisconsin data center rate plan
item.description: Wisconsin regulators heard public concerns over We Energies' proposed data center rate, with debate over cost shifting, $5B projects and ratepayer impact.

item.title: WSB expands expertise through three acquisitions
item.description: Golden Valley-based design and consulting firm WSB has expanded its leadership team following the company’s recent acquisitions.

item.title: LaSalle Plaza adds three food tenants
item.description: LaSalle Plaza in downtown Minneapolis welcomes Erberts & Gerberts, Confetti Blossom, and Still Grind Coffee, expanding food and beverage options for workers.

item.title: Kraus-Anderson wraps up $24.7M arena project
item.description: Kraus-Anderson has finished a $24.7 million expansion of the NorthStar Ford Arena in Hermantown, featuring a modern ice arena and public walking track.

item.title: Walz warns of economic downturn from ICE surge
item.description: Twin Cities businesses are experiencing reduced revenue and staffing challenges due to increased ICE enforcement, with immigrant-owned businesses hit hardest.

item.title: U.S. job growth surges, unemployment falls to 4.3%
item.description: U.S. job growth accelerated in January as unemployment fell to 4.3%, but major payroll revisions signal underlying labor market weakness.

item.title: Hugo weighs housing, retail on challenging site
item.description: A 97-acre mixed-use project in Hugo would bring 290 homes, 95,000 square feet of commercial space, parks and trails to the Frenchman Road site.

item.title: St. Louis Park OKs 33-unit apartment on Minnetonka Blvd.
item.description: St. Louis Park City Council approved Sela Investments’ 33-unit Parkway on 5 apartment project at Minnetonka Boulevard and Highway 100.
